purpose: Google Play Health Connect refusal remediation without removing useful Health Connect capabilities.
changes: Split Health Connect permission requests into import/read and export/write flows.
WRITE_HEART_RATE now writes real sensor heart-rate samples when recorded.
WRITE_SPEED now writes sensor speed or speed derived from recorded GPS points.
WRITE_STEPS now writes real measured step cadence through StepsCadenceRecord.
Optional Health Connect reads are permission guarded.
RUNNING PERF shows explicit Health Connect import/export disclosure and separate authorization actions.
Health Connect rationale screen explains the visible fitness use case.
New release bumped to rc16 / code 17.
Added a Health Connect compliance regression check to the Play AAB command.
Added exact Play Console declaration guidance.
